description.narrative:
The purpose of the CS4EU Programme is to support and enhance EU integration related reforms in Serbia through an advanced role of civil society organisations and media. The role of civil society is essential for promotion and establishment of rule of law and human rights protection, i.e. fulfilment of Copenhagen criteria for EU accession. Through the Programme CSOs and media will be supported to act as advocates of citizens interests in decision-making process and the EU accession negotiation. The programme aims to contribute to CSOs democratic capacities and strengthen CSOs and media for greater impact on society during the EU accession process.
The objectives of the intervention have not changed and the intervention continues to supports SDG 16: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels".

Organisationen Belgrade Open School (BOS), Serbien har hos Sida ansökt om 15 miljoner kronor för finansiering av programmet "CS4EU-Civil Society as a Force for a Change in the Serbia's EU Accession Process" under perioden 2016-2019. Insatsen syftar till att ge det civila samhällets organisationer möjlighet att ta aktiv del i Serbiens EU-process.
Programmets totala budget är 15 miljoner kronor. Cirka 7,5 miljoner kronor (3 omgångar x 15 bidrag, core och projekt stöd) av programmets budget kommer att vidarebefordras från organisationen BOS till serbiska civilsamhällesorganisationer.
Det är Sidas bedömning att det föreslagna programmet är i linje med Sveriges Resultatstrategi för reformsamarbete med Östeuropa, Västra Balkan och Turkiet för perioden 2014-2020 och att programmet bör bidra till civilsamhällesorganisationers potential att skapa möjligheter för att påverka samhällsutveckling och EU-närmande med dess värdegrund.
Insatsen kommer att bidra till ett effektiv operationalisering av Resultatstrategi avseende Strategi Resultat R8 under strategiperioden.
efficient operalisation of the Results Strategy and Strategy Result R8 in the strategy period

Specific objective 1 - To enhance the role of civil society in improving policy framework within decision making processes by representing communities' interests.
Result 1: Since the Constitutional Amendments were adopted in January 2022, Prosecutors Association of Serbia (PAS) representatives had their key proposals and recommendations adopted while participating in Government Working Groups that created a draft of Law on Public Prosecutors and Law on High Council of Prosecution. Therefore, PAS enhanced its advocacy role as a representative association of public prosecutors.
Result 2: One of the main results achieved in accordance with this specific objective came from Uzice. Our partners from Uzice Child Rights Center (UCRC) launched an initiative with recommendations for improvement of General Protocol for Protection of Children. Those recommendations proposed recognition of business sector as the bearer of responsibility for prevention of violence against children. Recommendations were accepted by Working group of Government of Serbia, while General Protocol for Protection of Children was also adopted this year by the Network of Organizations for Children of Serbia.
Result 3: For the first time in Serbia, Mental Disabled Rights Initiative Serbia (MDRI-S) prepared, created, published and presented Zero report on the position of people with disabilities in Serbia. Report covers most important areas of social life and deals with issues of realizing inalienable and basic human rights. Also, MDRI-S contributed to European Commission Report on Serbia for 2022 about position on mental disabled people in Serbia.
Specific objective 2 - To increase quality of information related to EU accession process and democratic reforms in Serbia.
Result 1: In 2022 BOS team published 11 issues of "Let's Talk About Negotiations" newsletters, each contain six to seven articles, op-eds, analysis, interviews etc. Newsletter is published every last Wednesday in month and distributed to more than 4 thousand subscribers. One innovation was introduced during 2022 - BOS team organized, edited and wrote 7 in-depth analyses on Serbias EU accession negotiation process. Six analyses cover six negotiation Clusters and one analysis covers two negotiation Chapters (34, 35) which remained out of the Clusters due to their specific topics. Apart from analysis and other text, BOS team is daily updating portal "Let's Talk About Negotiations" that had more than 48.000 pageviews from January to December 2022. Web-portal remained the most relevant hub for all information and knowledge on Serbia's EU Accession process.
Result 2: Media partner the European Western Balkans (EWB) web-portal with their news, analysis and interviews contributed to increasing quality information on EU accession process and the EU policies. During 2022 CCP published on their portal EWB 25 analysis, 25 texts, 6 interviews and 3 video interviews. Significant change in contribution to quality information on EU Accession process is creating a documentary film. Producing a high-quality film is a key result in the year 2022. Film is called "The Time of Stabilitocracy" and was premiered in December in Belgrade and will be broadcasted on several national TV channels in the Western Balkans and premiered in Brussels.
Specific objective 3 - To establish and improve the connections between civil society organizations and business sector within their joint participation in the EU accession process and development framework.
Result 1: BOS provided support to three previously established joint actions of civil and business sector. Uzice Child Right Center (UCRC) established connection with school of languages Berlitz utilizing that connection to introduce the General Protocol for Protection of Children to Berlitz resulting their adoption of the Protocol. UCRC had support of PR agency Kontakta, provided by BOS. PR agency created a national campaign promoting results achieved by UCRC. National campaign was visible on national media (N1, Prva TV, Nedeljnik, BizLife, Radio Beograd). Same agency provided support to Association Our house that employs people with disabilities. Support was based on creating a promotional video telling a story behind the Association and its cooperation with OTP Bank. Partners from MDRI-S established close connection with ManPower Group. Together with ManPower Group MDRI-S organized couple of workshops for people with disabilities. Now, those people are in ManPower candidate database for labour market.
Result 2: During 2022 BOS created a Manual for previously presented Guideline for establishing cooperation between civil and business sector. Therefore, BOS team organised a training for representatives of civil and business sector in July 2022. Also, BOS two-day Annual Networking Conference Move.Link.Engage 22 "The Power of Partnership" dealt with improvement of cooperation between civil and business sector in their jointly action. More than 150 representatives of civil and business sector attended the Conference as participants, keynote speakers, moderators and panellists.
